title: Parallel Logic Expert with Operator Routing
tools: AI Reasoning (Mixture of Experts, Fuzzy Logic) · Machine Learning (PyTorch)
blurb: A mixture-of-experts transformer that routes token representations through fuzzy-logic operators. Pre-registered result: the parallel branch gains 1.4 points, but the logic operators add nothing over a matched control.
long: Built a mixture-of-experts transformer that routes token representations through specialized logical operators (differentiable AND, OR and NOT), with cross-attention between the main model and those reasoning paths, plus the PyTorch training and evaluation pipeline.

The evaluation was pre-registered and run over three seeds. The parallel branch with its fusion head beats the linear-head baseline by 1.4 percentage points in every seed. But a parameter-matched control with the same capacity and no logic operators does just as well on ProofWriter and MNLI (Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference), so the gain comes from capacity, not logic.
Routing diagnostics show which operators the router actually uses at each depth. The project page has the full paper and an interactive playground.
highlights: +1.4 pp over the linear head in all 3 seeds
Logic operators = parameter-matched control (an honest null)
